evidence.notes: Aggregate aliases can be used in HAVING and ordered result rows expose alias and exprN fields.
LAST_N_MONTHS and THIS_QUARTER execute against the deterministic local VM clock.
Local QueryLocator exposes getQuery() and an eager snapshot iterator for supported SOQL.

source.content: @isTest private class DataSoqlAggregateDateQueryLocatorTest { @isTest static void exercisesAggregateDateAndLocatorEdges() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100, RenewalDate__c = Date.today()); insert new Account(Name = 'Gamma', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 300, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 4, 15)); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 250, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 3, 15)); List<Object> grouped = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount, SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING accountCount > 1 ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC]; System.assertEquals(1, grouped.size()); Object groupRow = grouped.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot', groupRow.Rating); System.assertEquals(2, groupRow.expr0); System.assertEquals(400.0, groupRow.totalRevenue); List<Account> priorMonthRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = LAST_N_MONTHS:1]; System.assertEquals(1, priorMonthRows.size()); List<Account> quarterRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = THIS_QUARTER]; System.assertEquals(2, quarterRows.size()); Object locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', locator.getQuery()); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account first = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Acme', first.Name); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account second = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Beta', second.Name); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account third = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Gamma', third.Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); } }
